finding.claim: No already-ratified current D1-D7 operation presently provides a semantic law for contiguous NumericBuffer element-wise map suitable as a parallel CUDA workload.
reason: Current exact-domain callability is present for admitted D3-D5 operations, but these operations are scalar/list-structure mechanisms rather than a current-domain NumericBufferMap law.
A batch of independent scalar calls would be benchmark composition, not a semantic definition of buffer mapping, and therefore cannot authorize CML NumericBufferMap.
D6 is ratified semantic residency but currently has no admitted exact-domain runtime mechanism.
D7 is current semantic residency but has no callable Core-operation projection and must not be inferred callable from width.
